vxe: uxe' — its foot, its base; u- 'its' + xe' 'root, foot'
chi: chi — at, in, to; preposition (also optative 'let' before a verb) · chik — again: chic with its final c shared with the next word (xki chi k'ut, xech'a chi k'u) · chi — with, of (chi ixim 'with maize'); also 'that' before a verb (chi qajaj 'that we carve') · chi' — mouth (ca chi 'our mouth', qui chi 'their mouths'); noun, same letters as the preposition
puch: puch — also, and; particle tagging the second of a pair
caquix: Kaqix — Macaw (in Seven Macaw), the scarlet macaw; noun
cumal: kumal — by them; r- 'by' form rumal with 3pl ki-
e: e — they; plural marker before a noun or verb
hunahpu: Junajpu — Hunahpu; name, also a day in the calendar; meaning uncertain
vbi: ub'i' — its name, called; u- 'its' + b'i' 'name', possessed noun
vcab: ukab' — its second; u- 'its' + kab' 'two', ordinal
cabauil: K'ab'awil — god, deity; noun, the old K'iche' word for a god (uncertain etymology)
rumal: rumal — by, because of, through; relational noun r- 'its' + umal 'cause, agent'
ri: ri — the, that (definite article/relative marker, e.g. ri Tepew 'the Sovereign'); particle
rib: rib' — itself; reflexive noun r- 'its' + ib' 'self'
xrah: xraj — wanted; x- completive + r- 'he, it' (3sg ergative before a vowel) + aj 'want', the wanted action following as a noun
chuvach: chuwach — on the face of; chi + u- 'its' + wach 'face', relational noun
vꜭux: Uk'u'x — its heart; u- 'its' + k'u'x 'heart, centre'; in Uk'u'x Kaj 'Heart of Sky'
cah: kaj — sky (also 'four' in the cord passage); noun
xꜭha: xch'a — said; x- completive + ch'a 'say', the singular of xech'a
cu: k'u — then, so; narrative connective, variant of k'ut · ku — k- 'ongoing' + u- 'he', written cu like the particle (cu nimarizah rib 'he makes himself great')
ta: ta — then, when, so that; particle introducing a following clause, also marks wishes/purpose · ta — hear, understand; transitive verb (xki ta 'they heard')
chuxoc: chuxoq — let it be; ch- optative + ux 'become' + -oq
vleu: ulew — earth, land; noun; u- here part of the word, not 'its'
cut: k'ut — then, and so; narrative connective particle
ca: qa — we, our; qa- 'our' or 'we' before a verb · ka — (uncertain) in que ka k'o, 'there will yet be'; k- 'ongoing' + a · ka — k- 'ongoing' before a verb or state word, written apart (ka pichipoj '(they) are pichipoj', uncertain; ma ka jisaj, k- + a- 'you')
chuvi: chuwi' — on top of; chi + u- 'its' + wi' 'head, top', relational noun
vi: wi — there, here, in it; locative particle (points back to a place or time) · wi' — head, top (pa ki wi' 'on their heads')
coh: koj — we, us (shall); k- 'shall' + oj 'we, us', before a verb (koj isik'ij 'you shall call on us') · koj — we, us (ongoing); k- 'ongoing' + oj 'we, us' (coh icuxih 'you chased us')
vpuvac: upuwaq — his silver, his wealth; u- 'his' + puwaq 'silver'
ronohel: ronojel — all, everything; quantifier, r- + onojel
are: are — this is, it is; demonstrative/copula pointing forward
vinaquir: winaqir — come into being, become a person; root winaq 'person' + -ir inchoative
puvac: puwaq — silver, precious metal (said mostly of silver, Brasseur); noun
xeꜭha: xech'a — they spoke; x- completive + e- 'they' + ch'a(w) 'speak'
al: al — child (of a mother); noun, paired with k'ajol 'son'
chire: chire — to him, to her; chi + r- 'him/her' + e
zaquiric: saqirik — it dawned; saq 'white' + -ir + -ik (dawn, in a couplet with xꜫec)
vinaquiric: winaqirik — coming into being; winaqir + -ik, verbal noun
quib: kib' — themselves, one another; ki- 'their' + -ib' reflexive
va: wa — this; demonstrative · wa — food, the maize tortilla (ca va 'our food', modern wa)
ꜫih: q'ij — day, sun; noun (Ratit Q'ij 'Grandmother of the Day'); in ki q'ij 'their day' perhaps 'their lot, fortune' (uncertain)
chirih: chirij — behind it; chi + r- 'its' + ij 'back', relational noun
cahau: kajaw — father; noun, paired with chuch
maha: maja — not yet; negative adverb (compare majab'i)
oc: oq — yet, still; adverb of continuing state · ok — enter; verb (que rah oc pa hul 'they want to enter a hollow')
xnohix: xnojix — it was conceived (inferred); x- completive + noj 'conceive, think out' + passive -ix; Brasseur takes the root as 'fill'
camic: kamik — died, dying; cam 'die' + -ic (xoh camic 'we died')
cute: k'ute — then, so; longer form of k'ut
xchicabyih: xchiqab'yij — we shall say, we shall tell; xchi- 'shall' + qa- 'we' + b'yij 'say', as in ca byih in the second part
vvach: uwach — its face; u- 'its' + wach 'face, surface', possessed noun
hutaꜫih: jutaq'ij — every day; jun 'one' + taq 'each' + q'ij 'day'
xac: xak — blackened with soot (inferred, from Brasseur's French 'smoking our mouths and our faces')
cate: k'ate — then, only then; narrative particle
chu: chu — at, by its (before a noun); let it (before a verb); chi 'at' + u- 'its' (chu jutaq chob'il 'by each division'), or ch- 'let' + u- 'it' (chu riqo 'let it find')
xpe: xpe — it came; x- completive + pe 'come'
vloc: uloq — hither, this way; adverb with verbs of coming
ꜩam: tzam — nose, beak tip (the macaw's great beak); noun
ma: ma — not, nor, or (in a question); negative/interrogative particle
tah: taj — let it be, may it; Classical optative particle (in modern K'iche' taj is a negative)
naquipa: naqipa — what; naqi 'what' + pa, in naquipa rumal 'why, for what reason'
mi: mi — now, just now; particle, as mi- in mixutzinik
la: la — unexplained particle in kat kix la uloq; uncertain
ve: we — if, whether; conjunction · we — (uncertain) teeth, following Brasseur ('my teeth shine'), in nay pu ve raxcavacoh
chic: chik — now, already, also; adverb of changed state · chik — any more (mawi xki nataj chik 'they no longer remembered'); in their turn, also
ꜫaꜫ: q'aq' — fire; noun (pa ꜫaꜫ 'in the fire')
chirech: chirech — about it, of it; chi + rech 'of, belonging to it'
zac: saq — white, light; adjective, root saq
que: ke — thus, as; adverb of manner · ke — k- 'ongoing' + e 'they', before a verb (xa ke wachelajik 'they kept on screeching') · qe — for us (uncertain); qa- 'our, us' set (tzuqul qe, k'o'l qe) · ke — of them (banol ke 'maker of them'), compare kech
zaqui: Saqi — white; part of name Saqi Nimaq Tz'yis 'Great White Coati'
chique: chike — to them; chi 'to' + ke 'them' · chiqe — to us (inside speech); chi + qe 'us' (Ximénez's qu stands for both k and q; the toggle shows chiqe)
quix: kix — you all (with an ongoing/commanded action); k- + ix 'you (pl.)' · kix — (uncertain) a verb after kat, 'be ashamed' or 'prick' (inferred), in kat kix la uloq
ꜫab: q'ab' — hand, arm; noun (ki q'ab' 'their hands')
ruꜭ: ruk' — with him/it; relational noun r- 'its/his' + uk' 'company'
chivih: chiwij — about yourselves; chi + iv- 'your (pl.)' + ih 'back' (to think behind oneself is to take thought)
bano: b'ano — do, make; b'an 'do, make' + -o, the ending of a transitive verb (xki b'ano 'they made it')
ꜭha: ch'a — says, said; ch'a 'say' (ca ꜭha 'he says', ca- ongoing; Ꜭha 'says' closing a speech)
ꜭoh: koj — puma; noun (read as puma, uncertain; Brasseur 'lion') · k'oj — in kotz k'oj, a phrase of unknown meaning (Brasseur 'dried cheeks'); not the puma; uncertain
i: i — your (pl.); 2pl possessive prefix, as in i poy 'your effigies'
